title: Omega Codex Minimal Derivation Chain and Cosmos Roadmap DAG
description: Directed acyclic graph classifying every node in the Omega Codex program into DERIVED (checked in Lean 4.33.0 or stdlib Python with source-bound receipts), OWED (explicit host admissions, supplied premises, unfreezing choices, and open bridge obligations), and IMAGINED (downstream WDP, L1/L2, finite quantum, gauge, gravity, and self-hosting metatheory targets still to come).

claim_hygiene_scope.supports: A deterministic, machine-auditable inventory of which derivation nodes are checked by Lean 4.33.0 and stdlib Python in this repository (DERIVED), which premises or bridge steps remain supplied admissions or open proof obligations (OWED), and which downstream mathematical or physical stages are planned future targets (IMAGINED).
claim_hygiene_scope.does_not_support: Any claim that OWED or IMAGINED nodes are derived, any claim of zero-input creation from nothing, or any physical validation beyond the finite algebraic models checked in the cited files.
claim_hygiene_scope.narrowest_defensible_claim: All nodes in bucket DERIVED resolve to existing Lean 4.33.0 theorems (checked under allowed axioms propext and Quot.sound) and/or stdlib Python check scripts in this checkout, and all dependencies on OWED premises are explicitly typed as edges in the acyclic graph.
claim_hygiene_scope.next_test_needed: Constructive discharge or minimal-premise reduction of the OWED bridge nodes, starting with OWE-07 (internal witnessing invocation), OWE-08 (profile preorder and ten-stick reflection), and OWE-09 (residual-to-positive-weights bridge).

DERIVED.definition: Checked in Lean 4.33.0 (constructive core, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero Mathlib, allowed axioms restricted to propext and Quot.sound) and/or stdlib Python check scripts with source-bound verification receipts in docs/.

OWED.definition: Explicitly priced host substrate admissions (S0-S5), unfreezing mechanism choices (M1-M3), and open bridge obligations where a claim in the historical or target chain requires a premise not forced by prior derived nodes alone.

IMAGINED.definition: Planned downstream extensions still to come: higher semi-simplicial WDP complexes, observer presheaf cohomology, L1-to-L2 complex phase amplitude bridge, finite quantum mechanics (Born/Gleason/CPTP/MUB), finite gauge sectors, simplicial Regge gravity, constructor theory, and self-hosting Cosmos metatheory.

nodes.title: Constructive Type-Theoretic Host Substrate (S0)
nodes.statement: The dependent type theory of Lean 4.33.0 (types, functions, inductive types, equality, quotients, propext, and Quot.sound) is supplied by the formal host environment and is not derived from empty nothingness.

nodes.title: Inhabited Off-Diagonal Mark Witness (S1)
nodes.statement: To instantiate a concrete mark, one must supply a type alpha, a binary relation R, and an inhabited off-diagonal witness (a, b) with R a b and a != b. An empty or singleton carrier admits no such witness.

nodes.title: Symmetry Extension, Composition Law, Retention Axis, and Cost Target Admissions (S2-S5)
nodes.statement: Extending directed difference D2 to symmetric apartness S2 (S2), equipping endomorphisms with composition (S3), adding a state retention bit (S4), and pricing arity or cochain defects via an additive norm (S5) are explicit structural admissions.

nodes.title: Post-Seal Unfreezing Mechanisms: Multiplicity, Indexed Family, or Dynamics (M1-M3)
nodes.statement: Because S2Bool has exactly two elements and C2 has one non-identity involution, any post-seal growth beyond cardinality 2 requires choosing at least one unfreezing mechanism: carrier multiplicity |alpha| >= 3 (M1), an indexed family of regimes/contexts (M2), or an external step/history index (M3).

nodes.title: Primitive Difference, Soundness Equivalence, and Two-Slot Counterpart Involution
nodes.statement: Global pairwise soundness of a relation R (every related pair is non-identical) is equivalent to irreflexivity of R; a local off-diagonal pair does not force global irreflexivity on larger carriers; on Bool, S2 is irreflexive, symmetric, and complete off-diagonal with unique counterpart involution.

nodes.title: Two-Position Relation Census, C2 Torsor Displacement, and Closure/Merger Algebra
nodes.statement: Among the 16 binary relations on Bool, 4 are irreflexive (empty, D2, D2rev, S2Bool); D2 has trivial automorphism group while S2Bool has automorphism group C2 = {id, flip} acting freely and transitively as a C2-torsor; idempotent closure and diagonal merger collapse difference.

nodes.title: Two-Step Duplication Radix 2^t, Single-Op Stall, and List-Length Radix Bound (OQ-01 / RT-03)
nodes.statement: Iterating a single self-inverting operation f^2 = id reaches at most 2 states along any orbit; binary pair-tree duplication reaches 2^t leaves at depth t; any list-expansion step of per-item length L <= 1 cannot increase list length, making L = 2 the minimal expanding radix.

nodes.title: Mirror Non-Identification and Internal-vs-External Asymmetry
nodes.statement: Under swap-equivariant access on S2Bool, internal observation-only procedures give identical outputs on both slots, whereas external referent-indexed identity queries distinguish them; symmetry-preserving multi-element offers avoid single-choice collapse on Fin 3.

nodes.title: Kernel Zero-Equivalence, Residual Quotient Factorization, and Boundary Non-Determination
nodes.statement: Every observation kernel K : alpha -> beta induces an equivalence relation zeroRel; the canonical map factors injectively through ResidualQuotient K; collapse to a subsingleton quotient holds iff all pairs are zero-related; static kernel equivalence does not determine terminal behavior under admissible extensions.

nodes.title: Pruned 4-Tuple Regime4, Mention Irrelevance, Permutation Invariance, and Kernel Bridge
nodes.statement: Separability in the 6-tuple WDP regime is independent of rule lists and mention tags, reducing faithfully to the 4-tuple Regime4 = (items, forms, insts, eval); collapsed4 coincides with the joint ZeroEquivalence.Kernel over all instantiated forms; Delta-extensions preserve prior separability and are invariant under item/form bijections.

nodes.title: Binary Arity-Weight Uniqueness mu(2) = 1 and Three-Item Unary Scope Boundary (OQ-04 / RT-01)
nodes.statement: Under positive arity weights (w(k) >= 1 for k >= 1), unary exclusion on the two-item target, and unit minimum witnessing cost, w(2) = 1 is uniquely forced across all functions Nat -> Nat; however, if w(1) = 0 is allowed on a 3-item carrier {0,1,2}, a unary form separating item 2 can witness (0,2) at cost 0 while keeping (0,1) unseparated, showing that positive unary weight or pair-scoped exclusion is required.

nodes.title: Multi-Round Closure Bounds and Non-Monotonic Unrequested-Pair Re-Collapse (OQ-05 / RT-09)
nodes.statement: Batch closure takes at most 1 round and sequential pair closure takes at most |K| rounds over requested pairs K; however, a non-append-only repair step that overwrites evaluations can separate a requested pair (0,1) while re-collapsing an unrequested pair (1,2), showing that monotonicity requires append-only Delta extensions.

nodes.title: Five-Mode Refusal Hierarchy and Tagged vs Untagged Reification
nodes.statement: On duplicate inputs, silent refusal and external meta-markers leave data state unchanged; fact-bit recording mutates state without growing the item carrier; untagged and tagged reification grow the carrier by 1 while the tag bit separates their outputs.

nodes.title: Exact 16/1024 Two-Step Retaining Laws, 4/1024 Drift-Free Law, and Multi-Step Idle Drift (OQ-03 / RT-02)
nodes.statement: Out of 2^10 = 1024 truth tables for (x', m') = F(x, m, e), 16 satisfy two-step retention (8 state updates x 2 output readouts), and 4 satisfy idle drift-freeness and slot symmetry; a law in the 16\4 slice that flips m on idle steps loses retention at 2 idle steps, whereas drift-free laws preserve memory across arbitrary idle horizons k >= 0.

nodes.title: Choice-Free Finite Report Factorization, Image Invariance, and Unary-vs-General Fiber Congruence (OQ-06 / RT-05 / RT-10)
nodes.statement: On Fin n, report r factors through history summary h via constructive table lookup decodeFin iff r is constant on h-fibers; on the image of h, decodeFin is independent of scan order and default fallback value, while off-image queries return the default; unary congruence across all unary predicates p : Fin n -> Bool is equivalent to fiber constancy for arbitrary output types.

nodes.title: Closure-vs-Symmetry-Break Duality and 5-Gate WDP-to-Horizon Morphism (RT-06 / OQ-08)
nodes.statement: An unseparated pair (u, v) fails closure under predicate P iff the transposition swap(u, v) is an internal symmetry breaking P; refining P by a distinguishing predicate Q closes the current obstruction; the 5-gate WDP morphism commutes with 3-gate Horizon projection iff admission and retention costs vanish.

nodes.title: F2 vs Z Triangle/Tetrahedron Coboundary d^2 = 0, Orientation Intertwiner, and Vortex Defect (OQ-02 / RT-04)
nodes.statement: On a 3-cycle and 4-simplex (tetrahedron), unsigned incidence satisfies d^2 = 0 over F2 but fails over Z; signed orientation satisfies d1 o d0 = 0 and d2 o d1 = 0 over Z; cyclic edge orientation intertwines with simplicial boundary signs via diag(1, 1, -1); the unit vortex 1-cochain has non-zero curl d1(w_vortex) = 1 and minimum L1 coboundary defect >= 1.

nodes.title: Edge-Transitive vs Non-Transitive Positive L1 Weight Forcing (OQ-07 / RT-11)
nodes.statement: Positive edge weights w_i > 0 on the 3-cycle are forced equal (w1 = w2 = w3) under cyclic edge-transitive symmetry, whereas without symmetry or under a non-transitive involution swapping only edges 2 and 3, unequal positive weights (w1 = 1, w2 = w3 = 2) remain invariant and tilt minimum-cost repair toward edge 1.

nodes.title: Off-Diagonal Fixed-Pair Criterion for Natural Sections and Twisted Holonomy Obstruction (RT-07 / RT-08)
nodes.statement: An endomorphism f : X -> X admits an f-equivariant section of the terminal projection iff f fixes an off-diagonal pair (a, b) with a != b; a single carrier fixed point on Fin 3 while swapping the other two elements does not suffice; on a C2 triangle, untwisted transports glue uniquely per base value while twisted transports with holonomy true have pairwise solutions but no global section.

nodes.title: Six-Guard Constitutional Initiality of D2_0 and Guard Independence Countermodels
nodes.statement: Within the finite candidate catalog, the bare directed difference D2_0 is the unique candidate satisfying all six constitutional guards (inhabited off-diagonal, irreflexive, asymmetric, minimal carrier, no extra labels, no extra operations), and each guard has an explicit independence countermodel violating only that guard.

nodes.title: Unapplied Outside Irrelevance, Re-Entry Accounting, and Lawvere/Cantor Diagonal Non-Exhaustion
nodes.statement: An unapplied external label leaves Regime4 separability unchanged and re-entry preserves item/form/instance counts; no internal indexing map enc : alpha -> (alpha -> Bool) surjects onto all predicates on alpha because diagNeg(a) = !enc(a)(a) differs at every a, forcing a strict reflective tower at every finite stage.

nodes.title: Monotonic Cumulative Measure and Strict No-Return Law
nodes.statement: Any append-only transition that strictly increases the cumulative regime measure mu(R) = |items| + |forms| + |insts| is irreflexive and asymmetric, preventing return to any prior regime state along non-empty positive-step chains.

nodes.title: Minimal Derivation Chain Audit and Post-Seal Pruning Census (OQ-01 to OQ-08, RT-01 to RT-12)
nodes.statement: All 8 open questions (OQ-01 through OQ-08) and 12 red-team boundary stress tests (RT-01 through RT-12) have executable Lean 4.33.0 proofs and stdlib Python check suites establishing exact finite scope conditions and countermodels.

nodes.title: Anchored Historical Seed Audit Record and Hash Manifest
nodes.statement: The historical Genesis seed audit record in evidence/seed_audit_2026-11-01/ is preserved with SHA-256 integrity checks, normalized claim-class counts, and separation between historical narrative and constructive Lean 4 verification.

nodes.title: Pre-Genesis Diamond-to-Root Bridge Obligation
nodes.statement: In the historical pre-Genesis narrative, the transition from pre-structural diamond/void language to an inhabited off-diagonal root witness is not forced by pure logic; it remains an explicit owed bridge (or must be replaced by explicit admission S1).

nodes.title: Genesis-to-Window Multiplicity and Finite Carrier Selection Bridge
nodes.statement: Moving from the sealed 2-position mark S2Bool to a finite multi-element window Fin n (n >= 3) requires an explicit multiplicity admission (M1) or iterated product construction (M2/M3) rather than emerging from S2Bool alone.

nodes.title: Internal Witnessing Invocation, Acquisition, and Retention Dynamic Bridge
nodes.statement: While the algebraic effects of applying a new form Delta are derived in MinimalSeparation.lean, the dynamic mechanism that selects and acquires a specific witnessing form when an internal observer encounters a collision remains an owed specification step.

nodes.title: Profile Preorder Comparison, Ten-Stick Reflection, and Four-Step Lift Bridge
nodes.statement: The historical Genesis steps for profile preorder comparison (N19), ten-stick reflection (N20), and four-step lift to additive/archimedean magnitudes (N21-N22) depend on unformalized ordering and reflection admissions not yet reduced to constructive Lean 4 theorems.

nodes.title: Residual Quotient to Canonical Positive Cochain Weights Bridge
nodes.statement: As shown in OQ-07 and RT-11, uniform positive L1 weights are forced only when the automorphism group acts transitively on the support; on asymmetric or non-edge-transitive quotient graphs, a canonical weight assignment remains an owed bridge.

nodes.title: Archimedean/Cauchy Real Completeness and Continuum Bridge
nodes.statement: Finite counting and rational defect ratios do not generate Cauchy-complete real numbers R without an explicit infinite completion or continuum limit admission; any downstream use of continuum real analysis is an owed admission.

nodes.title: Higher k-Simplex WDP Cochain Complexes and Non-Abelian Presheaf Cohomology
nodes.statement: Generalize the 2-simplex triangle and 3-simplex tetrahedron boundary theorems in LocalGlobalObstruction.lean to arbitrary k-dimensional semi-simplicial complexes, non-abelian Cech 1-cocycles, and exact primal-dual L1 minimal repair witnesses.

nodes.title: Observer Functor, Causal Diamonds, and Local Clock Synchronization
nodes.statement: Construct the functor from finite posets of local observer windows (causal diamonds) to residual quotients and transport holonomies, deriving relational proper-time ticks from irreducible state-update counts.

nodes.title: L1-to-L2 Parseval Phase Bridge and Complex Hilbert Amplitude Emergence
nodes.statement: Bridge discrete L1 cochain transport defects and cyclic C2/C4 phase holonomies to L2 inner-product amplitudes via discrete Fourier/Parseval duality on finite groupoids.

nodes.title: Finite Quantum Mechanics: Born Rule, Finite Gleason Frame, and CPTP Channels
nodes.statement: Connect the Omega Codex minimal chain to finite-dimensional quantum probability: frame-function additivity, Born rule weights, Stinespring dilation, and completely positive trace-preserving (CPTP) channel dynamics.

nodes.title: Mutually Unbiased Bases (MUB), Tensor Composite Systems, and Entanglement
nodes.statement: Derive composite system tensor products, finite Weyl-Heisenberg clock-and-shift operators, mutually unbiased bases (including prime-power constructions and dimension-6 obstructions), and non-factorizable joint states.

nodes.title: Discrete Action Variational Principle, Noether Conservation, and Canonical Pairs
nodes.statement: Formulate discrete variational path sums over finite cochain histories, deriving discrete Noether currents and conjugate position-momentum commutation relations.

nodes.title: Finite Lattice Gauge Theory: U(1) QED, SU(2)xU(1) Electroweak, and SU(3) Color
nodes.statement: Extend C2 link holonomy on simplicial 2-complexes to non-abelian gauge groupoids, Wilson plaquette actions, discrete Gauss law constraints, and anomaly cancellation checks.

nodes.title: Simplicial 3D/4D Regge-Barbero-Immirzi Curvature and Discrete Einstein-Hilbert Action
nodes.statement: Couple simplicial 2-face deficit angles and edge-length assignments on 3D/4D triangulations to form a discrete Regge action with exact Bianchi identity conservation on dual cells.

nodes.title: Finite Constructor Theory, Irreversibility, and Landauer Erasure Cost
nodes.statement: Connect the 16/1024 memory retention laws, merger erasure (merger_erases), and strict measure monotonicity (strict_measure_no_return) to finite constructor tasks, admissible vs obstructed transformations, and thermodynamic erasure bounds.

nodes.title: Self-Hosting Cosmos Internal Mathematics, Proof Checker, and Reflective Closure
nodes.statement: Extend the internal metatheory slice (InternalMetatheory.lean) into a self-hosting finite syntax, type checker, and reflective stage compiler capable of internalizing each stage of the derivation DAG along the diagonal tower.
